note: Attacker-controlled glyph selection reaches the sbix strike lookup; the bounds check only rejects glyph IDs outside the face's glyph count and does not validate the PNG payload size.
The glyph record length is derived from table offsets and can be made small while still passing the earlier structural checks.
The code forms a pointer to the glyph record and then immediately dereferences fields from the record without checking that the embedded image data is long enough for a PNG header.
The PNG reference is consumed by the extents helper, which assumes the returned blob contains a complete PNG image.
If the blob is shorter than the fixed PNG header, this cast causes an out-of-bounds read in the sanitizer-reported sink path.
